born.why: The code prioritizes survival by instantly rejecting previously poisoned species, generalizing caution to similar-smelling/shaped fruits, and using a heuristic score based on smell to decide between eating, tasting (for learning), or leaving unknown but promising fruits.

The code prioritizes starvation avoidance and known safe foods, adds logic to prevent tasting unknown fruits when already full or carrying a different item to maximize efficiency, and ensures that once a fruit is identified as good (by eating/tasting it), future instances are eaten immediately while known poisons are always avoided.

The code prioritizes starvation, then strictly avoids known poisonous species and fruits that visually match known poisons, uses scent similarity to safe fruits to eat unknown ones confidently, and defaults to tasting to build knowledge unless hunger forces a risk.

This code improves survival by dynamically adjusting risk tolerance based on hunger and recent environmental harm rates, allowing Fagi to sample unknown fruits when hungry but avoiding them when satiated in risky conditions, while strictly retaining known poison avoidance.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when hunger is critical, avoids known poisons using Set lookups for efficiency, exploits proven safe species by eating them fully, and cautiously tastes unknown fruits only when hunger justifies the risk, while ignoring unknowns if not hungry or already carrying food to minimize unnecessary exposure.
This code improves survival by using trait-based inference to guess the safety of unknown fruits, allowing Fagi to eat safely when possible while still cautiously tasting truly novel items.
